title: Acoustic Exposure Dynamics Dataset
description: An anonymized companion dataset for studying privacy-preserving, long-term dB-only acoustic exposure dynamics in occupied office deployments. The release contains aggregate feature tables, mixed-effects model outputs, cross-deployment validation summaries, a real device-vs-reference-microphone in-situ calibration check, metadata, documentation, and anonymized publication figures. It excludes raw audio, raw high-frequency logs, exact calendar dates, clock times, customer names, team labels, original floor labels, and labeled floor-plan images.
